text: In accordance with the city-wide residential demolition control under Article II, Demolition Control, of Municipal Code Ch. 363, as amended by By-law No. 1009-2006, enacted by City Council on September 27, 2006 under the authority of Section 33 of the Planning Act, I refer the demolition application for 5 Pine Crescent, permit application No. 19 203718 DEM 00 DM to you, to decide whether to grant or refuse the application, including conditions, if any, to be attached to the permit. This staff report is regarding a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Refused the application to demolish the subject detached single family dwelling at 5 Pine Crescent because there is no permit for replacement buildings on this site.
